Subject: Post-call recap + draft POC plan (next steps)

Thanks for joining the call earlier, Paul & Emily — good discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned before we start the trial: 

Summary / scope (as discussed)
- Core use case: production text generation for customer support summarization (ingest tickets -> generate concise summary + suggested response)
- Trial duration: 2 weeks (11/23 start, 12/07 end)
- Success criteria (primary): summary quality (mean rating >= 4/5 on sample set), end-to-end latency <= 300ms p95, no data exfiltration concerns in the flow

Evaluation plan
- Redwood will provide a test harness and an initial seed dataset (attached).
- Acme to run 200 test tickets through the harness and provide human quality ratings on a 1-5 scale.
- We'll capture latency and token counts; we'll also run an A/B with your current heuristic approach for comparison.

Ownership / timelines
- Redwood: Marissa (sales) - commercial lead; Camila (eng) - integration & infra; Dylan (solutions) - eval harness & metrics collection
- Acme: Paul - product owner; Emily - data contact for dataset and labeling
- Next check-in: kickoff call on Monday 11/22 at 11:00AM PT to validate dataset and test harness.

Attachments: acme_poc_draft_plan_v2.pdf (POC plan + measurement rubric)

Please reply with any changes — if this looks good I'll update the plan and send a DocuSign SOW for the POC committal (standard evaluation terms).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A couple of updates from our side after talking with the product and ML teams: 

1) Add an additional NLU classification use case mid-trial
- Business need: classify incoming tickets into 10 intent buckets to drive routing automation. This would be valuable to validate during the same window.
- Success criteria (for classification): per-class precision/recall >= 0.80 and macro-F1 >= 0.82 on our holdout set.

2) Tighter latency requirement for production readiness
- We'd like to target end-to-end p95 latency <= 200ms for the classification path if possible. We understand this may affect cost & infra configuration.

3) Data & test assets
- Attaching a small sample set and a labeling spec: acme_nlu_sample_set.csv (contains 500 labeled rows). We'll share the full holdout once we sign off on the POC terms.

Can you confirm impact on timeline and whether you can run both tracks in parallel? If parallel work isn't feasible, propose which to prioritize and the delta to the schedule and cost. Also loop in security contact — they may send a short questionnaire before we run any live data.

-Paul

Appreciate the detailed asks, Paul — great signal on what matters. Proposal to rebaseline the POC to accommodate the classification track without derailing the summarization work: 

Proposed rebaseline
- Parallel tracks: run Summarization (Track A) and NLU Classification (Track B) in parallel. Track B will use a lighter inference profile (quantized medium) for throughput testing.
- Updated success criteria:
  - Track A (Summarization): mean quality >= 4/5, p95 latency <= 300ms (unchanged)
  - Track B (Classification): macro-F1 >= 0.82, per-class precision/recall >= 0.80, p95 latency <= 200ms
- Timeline impact: shift final evaluation date to 2026-11-30 to allow parallel integration and 2 full days of validation per track. Kickoff (dataset & harness validation) still on 11/22; engineering work starts 11/23.
- Ownership:
  - Camila: engineering lead for both tracks (integration, infra config, quantization experiments)
  - Dylan: evaluation harness & metrics collection (will ingest your CSV and wire up labeling UI)
  - Michael: commercial lead for cost estimate and SOW updates (billing & procurement)

Cost & infra note
- Running both tracks in parallel will add roughly 30% more GPU-hours during the 2-week window; Michael will provide an updated estimate and an optional reserved-burst config to control unit cost.

Attachments: updated POC plan + proposed measurement rubric (acme_poc_draft_plan_v2.pdf) — I also added a placeholder for the security questionnaire link; please forward that when you have it.

Next steps
- Camila: can you confirm feasibility and any special infra requirements by EOD 11/19?
- Michael: please send a delta estimate + SOW changes by EOD 11/19 so Paul/Emily can expedite procurement.
- Paul/Emily: confirm you're comfortable with the 11/30 final evaluation date and share the full holdout dataset when ready.

If we agree, I'll update the plan and send an amended SOW (DocuSign) for signature.

Thanks,
